text: In 1848, a railroad worker named Phineas Gage was packing explosive powder. It blew up. An iron rod, over three feet long, shot through his skull.
He survived, and he could still walk and talk. But people said the old Phineas was gone. His personality had reportedly changed.
Which part of the brain was damaged? It sits at the very front, and it plans, decides, and shapes who you are.
